name: talentbook-mcp
description: Connects an agent to your own Talentbook data (goals, skills, OKRs, journal, consultations, org baselines) over MCP, with usage guidance for the tool catalog's scopes, idempotency keys, and rate limits.

talentbook_server_url.title: Talentbook server URL
talentbook_server_url.description: The MCP endpoint, including the trailing slash — e.g. https://talentbook.io/mcp/ for production, or http://localhost:8888/mcp/ for a local dev server. The trailing slash is required; a URL missing it fails to connect.

talentbook_pat.title: Talentbook personal access token
talentbook_pat.description: A tb_pat_... token from Talentbook's /app/connected-agents page, scoped to what you want this agent to do (e.g. read:goals,read:skills,write:journal for a journaling assistant). Stored securely, never written to a plain settings file.
